::: {.bnr-manual-flag .bnr-manual-flag--technical}
Technical Manual
:::

## Listing sources

| Public listing | Source QMD | Landing pages discovered at render time |
|---|---|---|
| CVD Reports and Studies | `site/surveillance/cvd/index.qmd` | `reports/updates/*/index.qmd`, `reports/annual/*/index.qmd`, `reports/briefings/*/index.qmd`, `reports/studies/*/index.qmd` |
| Latest Surveillance Outputs | `site/news/index.qmd` | `../surveillance/*/reports/*/*/index.qmd` |

Both listings sort landing pages by date in descending order. The first uses a table layout; Latest Surveillance Outputs uses a card/grid layout.

## Required landing-page metadata

Generated report landing pages supply YAML fields such as:

```yaml
title: "Reader-facing title"
description: "Short public description"
date: YYYY-MM-DD
date-modified: YYYY-MM-DD
report-id: stable_versioned_identifier
report-type: Annual report
report-version: v1
image: /assets/images/listings/example.webp
image-alt: Short image description.
categories:
  - CVD
```

Report-specific fields may add a coverage period, source-release IDs, study ID or related report ID. Keep machine identifiers stable and dates in ISO form.

## Routine procedure

1. Complete the rolling, annual or one-off publication route. Use only the generated website landing page, never a private candidate.
2. Confirm the page is in the correct source folder and its linked PDF or data exists.
3. Run `quarto render` from `site/`.
4. Check both listings. Confirm the item appears once and in the expected date order.
5. Check title, description, report type, image, image alternative text and categories.
6. Open the listed page and all its public links.
7. Review the QMD, PDF and metadata changes before commit.

## Troubleshooting

- Missing item: check the directory pattern, filename `index.qmd`, YAML delimiters and `date`.
- Wrong order: check that `date` is a valid ISO date and describes the intended publication date.
- Duplicate item: check for two landing pages matching the listing patterns.
- Broken card or row: check `title`, `description`, `image` and `image-alt`.
- Broken PDF link: return to the report publication output mapping; do not hard-code a second copy into the listing.

The listings are indexes only. They do not approve, copy or transform reports.
